note: چیدن (to arrange, set out) carries making, which the Arendt passage needs: «چیدن واژه‌ای برای ساختن است». The noun, the composition of the room, is ترکیب اتاق.

Plain register: the word an adult says out loud, neither clinical nor crude. Don't make it polite. A term of labor satire, never set beside the kill chain (D-810). «جیش» leans slightly childish, as French «pipi» does, but adults use it. Clinical: «بطری ادرار»; crude: «بطری شاش». In Dari the everyday word is «پیشاب». Needs a native check.
